text: Play Headed Home only on a runner at third that has Speed A. Roll a die. 1-15: The runner is out, 16-20: The runner scores.

name: High Fives
text: If your last batter hit a homer, add +3 to the swing.

name: Lock It Down
text: Play Lock it Down only on a starter. Discard a card. If there are 2 outs and there's a runner in scoring position, add +1 to the pitch and subtract 1 from the swing. If your pitcher has the 20 icon, instead add +2 to the pitch and subtract 2 from the swing.

name: Long Gone!
text: Draw 2 cards. If a player with the R icon hit the home run, instead draw 3 cards.

name: New Arrival
when: Play on a walk result on the pitcher's chart.
text: If your pitcher has the R icon, reroll any walk result. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Not So Fast
when: Play on a single+ result or other attempt to steal without a throw.
text: Your catcher tries to throw the stealing player out. If he has the G icon, add +6 to the throw. If you throw the runner out, draw a card.

name: On the Move
text: Play On the Move only if there's a runner on first, or there are runners on first and second. The defense can't attempt to turn a double play. If you score any runs, draw a card.

name: Outmanaged
text: The opposing manager chooses 3 cards in his or her hand and shows them to you. Choose 1 of those cards and discard it. If the opposing manager has any players with the R icon in the game, instead choose 2 of those cards and discard them.

name: Pitch Around
text: Discard a card. Skip the pitch and the swing. The batter is intentionally walked. (This isn't a walk result.)

name: Rookie Fireballer
text: If your pitcher has the R icon, draw a card and your opponent discards a card.

name: Split-Finger Fastball
when: Play when the batter's swing is rerolled.
text: Subtract 3 from the reroll.

name: Stealing Signals
text: Look at your opponent's hand. You may discard a card from your hand and draw a card.

name: Still Learning
text: Add +2 to the throw. If the runner has the R icon, instead add +4 to the throw. If you throw the runner out, your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Swing at Anything
text: Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Take What's Given
text: Add +2 to the swing. If your batter rolls a homer, change the result to a single.

name: Three Up, Three Down
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: Discard a card. If this inning went 1-2-3 and your starter is still in the game, he gets +1 IP.

name: Triple Dip
when: Play after a successful double-play attempt.
text: If there were runners on the first and second and no outs, roll a die. 1-17: No effect. 18-20: The batter and both runners are out, and you draw 3 cards.

name: Who is This Guy?
text: Add +1 to the swing. If our batter has the R icon, instead add +3 to the swing. If your batter gets an out, discard a card.

name: Aces Up
when: Play on a 1B result on the pitcher’s chart.
text: Reroll the pitch and the swing. If your pitcher has the CY icon you may instead reroll the pitch and swing for any result (on the pitcher’s chart).

name: Bad Call
text: Discard a card. Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Burned
text: Add +4 to your next batter’s swing.

name: Caught Him Leaning
text: If there is a runner on first with Speed A and second base is open roll a die. 1-17: No effect. 18-20: The runner on first is out.

name: Caught the Corner
text: Subtract 1 from the batter’s swing. If the batter gets a SO result draw a card. If your pitcher has the K icon and the batter gets a SO result your opponent also chooses a card from his or her hand and discards it.

name: Change in Strategy
text: Draw 3 cards and then discard 3 cards.

name: Check Swing
when: Play on a SO result on the batter’s chart.
text: Discard 2 cards. Change the result to a BB. If your batter has the V icon you may play Check Swing on a SO result on the pitcher’s chart.

name: Choke
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: If the bases were loaded your opponent chooses and discards 3 cards from his or her hand. (If your opponent has only 1 or 2 cards discard all of them.)

name: Close Call
text: Discard a card. If the roll isn’t for a pitch or a swing add +2 to it or subtract 2 from it.

name: Cover Second
text: Choose either your second baseman or shortstop. Add that player’s Fielding to the defense’s total roll. If the chosen player has the G icon and the stolen-base attempt fails your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Deep in the Gap
text: Discard a card. Roll a die. If your roll ties or beats the center fielder’s Speed change the result to a 2B.

name: Dominating
text: If your pitcher is a closer and the batter gets an out result change the result to a SO.

name: Drained
text: If the pitcher is tired and there’s a runner on first with Speed A or Speed B he steals second without a throw. (You can steal a base only if it’s open.)

name: Ducks on the Pond
text: Discard a card. Add +1 to the swing for each runner.

name: Foul Ball
text: Discard a card. Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.) If your pitcher has the 20 icon your opponent also chooses a card from his or her hand and discards it.

name: Good Leather
text: Add +2 to a player’s Fielding for any roll. If that player has the G icon instead add +6 to his Fielding for any roll.

name: Great Addition
text: Discard a card. Add +1 to any roll. If your player has the RY icon instead add +2 to any roll. (You can use Great Addition to change a roll that has been made already.)

name: Hard Slide
text: Discard a card. The defense rerolls the double-play attempt.

name: Hooking Foul
when: Play on a 1B or 2B result on the pitcher’s chart.
text: If your pitcher is LHP and the batter bats L reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: In the Zone
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: If your pitcher got 3 SO results this inning add +2 to each of his pitches next inning.

name: Infield In
text: If first base is open and the batter gets a GB result runners on second and third don’t advance.

name: Inside the Park Home Run
text: If your batter is Speed A the defense makes an outfield Fielding check at +8. If it succeeds your batter is out and each runner scores. If it fails your batter and each runner scores. If your batter has the SB icon instead make the check at +3.

name: Lined Out of Play
when: Play on a 1B or 2B result on the pitcher’s chart.
text: If your pitcher is RHP and the batter bats R reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Locate
text: Leave this card on your pitcher until the end of the inning. If your pitcher gets a natural 20 on a pitch roll you may discard Locate to draw 4 cards.

name: Locked In
text: Your opponent chooses one: Subtract 2 from the swing; or you draw 2 cards.

name: Nerves of Steel
text: If your pitcher is a closer add +3 to the pitch.

name: New Strategies
text: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Your opponent chooses 2 of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the remaining card on the bottom of your deck.

name: Options
text: Choose one: Add +1 to the swing subtract 1 from the pitch or draw a card and then discard a card.

name: Out of the Frying Pan
text: Discard any number of cards. Look at your opponent’s hand and choose that many cards. Your opponent discards the chosen cards.

name: Paint the Corner
text: Discard a card. Subtract 2 from the swing. If your pitcher has the 20 icon draw a card.

name: Play the Percentages
text: If the pitcher is LHP and your batter bats R or S add +2 to the swing.

name: Pointers
when: Play before your batter’s swing is rerolled.
text: Add +3 to the reroll.

name: Poor Positioning
text: Add +1 to the swing. If the defense has any players with the R icon on defense instead add +3 to the swing.

name: Power Pitching
text: Subtract 3 from the swing. If the batter gets a FB result change the result to a HR. If your pitcher has the CY icon and the batter gets an out result draw 2 cards.

name: Pull the Ball
text: If the pitcher is RHP and your batter bats L or S reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Rough Outing
text: If at least 4 runs have been charged to your opponent’s pitcher he gets –1 IP.

name: Second Look
text: Reroll the attempt.

name: Short Fly
text: Change the result to a PU.

name: Sloppy Bunt
text: If the batter is a pitcher the lead runner is out. The batter and each other runner is safe.

name: Slow Roller
text: Subtract 3 from the defense’s roll.

name: Split-Finger Fastball
when: Play before the batter’s swing is rerolled.
text: Subtract 3 from the reroll.

name: Stick a Fork in Him
text: If the pitcher is tired reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Sweet Swing
text: If the pitcher is RHP and your batter bats L or S add +2 to the swing.

name: Swing at Anything
text: Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Take What’s Given
text: Add +2 to the swing. If your batter gets a HR result change the result to a 1B.

name: Think Again
text: If your opponent just played a card that made you discard Think Again return Think Again to your hand and draw a card.

name: Think Twice
when: Play on a reroll of a pitch or a swing.
text: Draw 2 cards.

name: Top-Level Strategy
text: If the batter is a pinch hitter and gets an out result your opponent reveals his or her hand. You choose 3 cards from his or her hand and discard them. (If your opponent has only 1 or 2 cards discard all of them.)

name: Tough as Nails
text: If there is a runner in scoring position with less than 2 outs subtract 2 from the swing. If your pitcher has the RP icon draw a card.

name: Turn on It
text: If the pitcher is LHP and your batter bats R or S reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Calculated Risk
text: The batter is intentionally walked. (This isn’t a BB result.) Return each offensive strategy card played this at-bat to its owner’s hand.

name: Chin Music
text: Discard a card. Leave this card on the batter who just walked. (It remains in play.) Subtract 1 from each of that batter’s swings.

name: Down the Middle
text: If the pitcher is tired change the result to a HR.

name: Dugout General
text: If it’s the 9th inning or later choose a card in your discard pile and return it to your hand.

name: Great Start
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: If your starter would be tired next inning and he’s given up 3 or fewer runs he gets +1 IP. (Playing another Great Start this inning won’t do anything.)

name: Grooved
text: Discard a card. If the bases are empty add +3 to the swing or subtract 2 from the pitch.

name: High and Tight
text: If your opponent’s last batter this inning got a hit result add +2 to the pitch or subtract 1 from the swing.

name: Intimidation
text: If the last batter struck out add +2 to the pitch.

name: Lost in the Sun
text: Discard a card. The defense makes a combined infield and outfield Fielding check. If it fails change the result to a 1B that doesn’t let runners try for extra bases.

name: Old Tricks
text: Choose 1 card in your discard pile and put it on the bottom of your strategy deck. Draw a card.

name: On Your Toes
text: Add +10 to your attempt. If you fail discard a card.

name: Out of Sync
text: Play Out of Sync after your opponent rolls a natural 1. Look at his or her hand and choose 2 cards. Your opponent discards those cards. (If your opponent has only 1 card discard it.)

name: Protect the Runner
text: Make a stolen-base attempt using a runner on first or second. Subtract 3 from the catcher’s roll. Add +2 to the pitch. (You can steal a base only if it’s open.)

name: Rally Killer
when: Play after a successful double-play attempt.
text: Your opponent discards 2 cards (1 if he or she has only 1).

name: Revelation
text: If you’re losing look at your opponent’s hand. Choose a card there and set it aside. You may play that set aside card as though it were in your hand. At the start of the next inning if you didn’t play that card put it into its owner’s discard pile.

name: Running on Fumes
text: If the pitcher is tired reroll the swing on your batter’s chart. (If he’s a pitcher use his chart anyway.)

name: Serious Wheels
text: Make a stolen-base attempt using a runner on first or second and add +5 to the runner’s speed. If your player has the {SB} icon steal without a throw. (You can steal a base only if it’s open.)

name: Setup Man
text: Play Setup Man only on a reliever. Subtract 2 from the swing. If your pitcher has the {RP} icon no more strategy cards may be played until the next at-bat.

name: Smash up the Middle
text: Discard a card. The second baseman and shortstop make a Fielding check. If it fails change the result to a 1B.

name: Stealing Signals
text: Look at your opponent’s hand. You may discard a card from your hand and draw a card.

name: Superior Talent
text: Leave this card on your batter until the end of the game. If your batter gets a natural 20 on a swing roll you may discard Superior Talent to draw 4 cards.

name: Superstar
text: Play Superstar only on a player with a point value of 500 or more. Discard a card. Add +2 to any roll. (You can use Superstar to change a roll that has been made already.)

name: Swat!
text: If your batter gets the advantage add +3 to the swing. If your batter gets the advantage and has the {S} icon draw a card. If your batter gets any out result change the result to a SO.

name: Timing
when: Play on a FB or GB result.
text: If a reliever or closer is on the mound roll a die. 1–5: Change the result to a SO. 6–16: Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.) 17–18: Change the result to a 1B. 19–20: Change the result to a 2B.

name: Whiff!
when: Play on a PU or SO result.
text: Look at the top 3 cards of your opponent’s strategy deck. Discard one of those cards and put the other 2 back on top of the deck in any order. (You don’t have to show your opponent the cards you put back.)

name: Beaned
text: You can’t play Beaned if another strategy card has been played or used this at-bat. The batter is intentionally walked (BB). Subtract 2 from the swing of the next batter.

name: Broken Bat
text: Roll a die. 1–5: Skip the pitch and the swing. The result is a GB on the pitcher’s chart. If a double-play attempt is made this at-bat add +5 to the roll. 6–20: No effect (foul ball). Roll for the pitch and the swing normally.

name: Caught Napping
when: Play on a hit or a FB result.
text: Runners with Speed C can’t try for extra bases this at-bat.

name: Chopper
text: The lead runner is out. Each other runner is safe. You can’t make a double-play attempt.

name: Dialed-In
text: Discard 2 cards. If there’s a runner in scoring position skip the pitch and roll for the swing on the batter’s chart. If the batter has the {S} icon draw a card.

name: Dying Quail
when: Play on a 1B or a 1B+ result.
text: Your opponent can’t make any extra-base attempts this at-bat.

name: En Fuego!
text: Leave this card on your batter. Add +1 to your batter’s On-Base. (Playing another En Fuego! on this player will have no effect.)

name: Feast or Famine
text: Discard a card. Reveal the top 4 cards of your strategy deck. Your opponent splits those cards into 2 face-up piles. Put 1 pile in your hand and put the other pile into your discard pile

name: Great Reactions
text: Choose one: Remove an offensive (red) card attached to a player; or you may have your opponent choose and discard a card.

name: Home-Field Advantage
text: If you’re the home team add +2 to the pitch or the swing.

name: Insult to Injury
text: Look at your opponent’s hand. Choose 1 of those cards and discard it.

name: Just Over the Rail
text: Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Last Chance
text: If there are 2 outs add +2 to the swing.

name: Late Call
text: Discard a card. If the roll isn’t for a pitch or a swing reroll it.

name: Lefty Shift
text: If the batter bats L add +1 to the Fielding of each player on defense this at-bat.

name: On the Move
text: Play On the Move only if there’s a runner on first if there are runners on first and second or if the bases are loaded. The defense can’t make a double-play attempt. If you score any runs draw a card.

name: Opposite-Field Power
when: Play on a 2B result on the batter’s chart.
text: Discard a card. If the pitcher is LHP and your batter bats R or S change the result to a HR. If your batter has the {S} icon you may play Opposite-Field Power on a 2B result on the pitcher’s chart instead.

name: Out of Gas
text: If the pitcher is tired add +3 to the swing.

name: Outmanaged
text: Your opponent chooses 3 cards in his or her hand and shows them to you. Choose 1 of those cards and discard it. If your opponent has any players with the {R} icon on his or her roster instead choose 2 of those cards and discard them.

name: Pumped Up
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: Draw a card for every batter your pitchers struck out this inning.

name: Punched Out
text: Leave Punched Out on the batter who just struck out. (It remains in play.) Before a pitch to the batter that has this card on it you may discard Punched Out to subtract 2 from the swing.

name: Quick Thinking
text: Choose one: Remove a defensive (blue) card attached to a player; or you may have your opponent choose and discard a card.

name: Robbed!
text: Discard a card. Subtract 1 from any roll. If your opponent has any player with the RY icon in the game, instead subtract 2 from any roll. (You can use Robbed! to change a roll that has been made already.)

name: Swing for the Fences
text: Add +2 to the swing. If your batter rolls a BB change the result to a SO.

name: Wheelhouse
when: Play on a 2B result on the batter’s chart.
text: Discard a card. If the pitcher is RHP and your batter bats L or S change the result to a HR. If your batter has the {S} icon you may play Wheelhouse on a 2B result on the pitcher’s chart instead.

name: 25th Man
text: Play 25th Man on your opponent's player with a point value of 50 or less. Discard a card. Subtract 2 from that roll. (You can use 25th Man to subtract from a roll that has already been made.)

when: Play after a successful double-play attempt.
text: Play 6–4–3 on one of your infielders. Leave this card on that player until the end of the game. That infielder’s Fielding is now +3. (Playing another 6–4–3 on this player will have no effect.)

name: Aces Up
when: Play on a 1B result on the pitcher’s chart.
text: Reroll the pitch and the swing. If your pitcher has the {CY} icon you may instead reroll the pitch and swing for any result on the pitcher’s chart.

name: Can of Corn
text: Your opponent can’t make any extra-base attempts this at-bat. If one of your outfielders has the {G} icon draw a card.

name: Change in Strategy
text: Draw 3 cards and then discard 3 cards.

name: Close Call
text: Discard a card. If the roll isn’t for a pitch or a swing add +2 to it or subtract 2 from it.

name: De-nied!
when: Play after a successful double-play attempt.
text: Draw 2 cards. If any of your infielders have the {G} icon instead draw 3 cards.

name: Fake to Third
text: Play Fake to Third only if there are runners on first base and third base. Roll a die. 1–3: The pitcher balks and each runner advances one base. 4–16: No effect. 17–20: The runner at first is out.

name: Fan Interference
when: Play on a FB or 3B result.
text: If you’re on defense change the result to a 2B that doesn’t let runners try for extra bases. If you’re on offense reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Field General
text: Play Field General only if you are losing and have less cards than your opponent. Draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent.

name: Fireballer
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: If your pitcher got 3 SO results this inning draw 2 cards and your opponent chooses and discards 2 cards from his or her hand.

name: Full Windup
text: If the bases are empty add +2 to the pitch.

name: Good Leather
text: Add +2 to a player’s Fielding for any roll. If that player has the {G} icon instead add +6 to his Fielding for any roll.

name: Goodbye Baseball!
when: Play on a walk or hit result.
text: Play Goodbye Baseball! on a batter who has a HR result of 18+ or lower or has the {HR} icon. Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.) If your batter has the {HR} icon add +3 to the swing.

name: Great Addition
text: Discard a card. Add +1 to any roll. If your player has the {RY} icon instead add +2 to any roll. (You can use Great Addition to change a roll that has been made already.)

name: Hacker
text: Add +3 to the swing. Change each BB and 1B result to a SO.

name: Helping Himself
text: Play Helping Himself on a pitcher who just got a hit on offense. Leave this card on your pitcher until the end of the game. Add +1 to each of his pitches and +3 to each of his swings. (Playing another Helping Himself on this player will have no effect.)

name: High Pitch Count
when: Play after a hit or walk result.
text: If the bases are loaded the pitcher gets –1 IP.

name: Hit the Foul Pole
text: Discard 1 card. Roll a die. 1–17: No effect. 18–20: Change the result to a HR.

name: Hooking Foul
when: Play on a 1B or 2B result on the pitcher’s chart.
text: If your pitcher is LHP and the batter bats L reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Intensity
text: Play Intensity only if the bases are loaded. Subtract 2 from the pitch or the swing.

name: Knuckleball
text: Roll a die. 1–2: Each runner advances one base and you roll again on this card. 3–5: Skip the pitch and swing; the result is a BB. 6–12: No effect. 13–20: Subtract 4 from the swing.

name: Lined Out of Play
when: Play on a 1B or 2B result on the pitcher’s chart.
text: If your pitcher is RHP and the batter bats R reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Make Contact
text: Discard a card. If there is a runner in scoring position change any BB result to a 1B result.

name: Masterpiece
text: Discard 2 cards. If the bases are empty skip the pitch and roll for the swing on the pitcher’s chart. If your pitcher has the {20} icon draw 2 cards and discard 1 card from your hand.

name: Mind Games
when: Play after your opponent makes a substitution.
text: Return a card in your discard pile to your hand.

name: New Strategies
text: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Your opponent chooses 2 of those cards. Put the chosen cards into your hand and the remaining card on the bottom of your deck.

name: Out Pitch
text: Leave Out Pitch on your pitcher until the end of the game. Change one type of out result on his chart (PU SO GB or FB) to another type of out result. (For example all FB’s become GB’s or all GB’s become SO’s.) (Once a type of out result is chosen it can’t be changed.)

name: Paint the Corner
text: Discard a card. Subtract 2 from the swing. If your pitcher has the {20} icon draw a card.

name: Playing Shallow
text: If the batter has a chart with a HR result of 21+ or more (or is a pitcher) reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.) If you have 2 or more outfielders with the {G} icon draw a card.

name: Pull the Ball
text: If the pitcher is RHP and your batter bats L or S reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Rattled
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: If your team scored 2 or more runs off the pitcher this inning he gets –1 IP.

name: Robbed!
text: Discard a card. Subtract 1 from any roll. If your opponent has any player with the {RY} icon on his or her roster instead subtract 2 from any roll. (You can use Robbed! to change a roll that has been made already.)

name: Role Player
text: Play Role Player on a player who didn’t start the game. Leave this card on your player until the end of the game. Add +1 to each of his swings. (Playing another Role Player on this player will have no effect.)

name: Scouting Report
text: You and your opponent each count the number of cards in your hands shuffle them into your decks and then draw that many cards. (Don’t count Scouting Report as a card in hand for the new draw.)

name: Scuffling
text: Play Scuffling on a pitcher who is tired. Leave this card on that pitcher until the end of the game. Subtract 3 from each of his pitches.

name: Second Look
text: Reroll the attempt.

name: See It Clearly
text: Subtract 1 from the pitcher’s roll. If your batter has the {S} icon instead subtract 3 from the pitcher’s roll.

name: Serious Wheels
text: Make a stolen-base attempt using a runner on first or second and add +5 to the runner’s Speed. If your player has the {SB} icon steal without a throw. (You can steal a base only if it’s open.)

name: Shut the Door
text: Play Shut the Door on a closer only if it's the ninth inning or later and the bases are empty. Leave this card on your pitcher until he gives up a hit or a walk. Add +2 to each of his pitches. If your pitcher has the {RP} icon draw a card. (Playing another Shut the Door on this player will have no effect.)

name: Sprint to Second
text: Use the Speed of your runner on first for the attempt. If the attempt fails your batter and runner are both safe. (If it succeeds they’re both out.)

name: Steal the Sign
text: Play Steal the Sign on a runner on second base. Leave this card on your player until the end of the game. Add +2 to each of his swings. (Playing another Steal the Sign on this player will have no effect.)

name: Swing at Anything
text: Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Turn on It
text: If the pitcher is LHP and your batter bats R or S reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Up and In
text: Discard a card. No more offensive strategy cards may be played until the next at-bat.

name: Upper-Deck Shot
text: Discard a card. Search your deck for any card reveal it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck. If the player who hit the HR has the {HR} icon your opponent chooses and discards 2 cards.

name: Valuable Asset
text: Discard a card. Add +2 to the swing. If your batter has the {V} icon draw a card.

name: Weakest Link
text: Play Weakest Link only if your opponent has a player with the {R} icon in his or her lineup. Reroll the swing. (Use the same chart as before.)

name: Work the Count
text: Change the result to a BB.

name: Working the Edge
text: Leave this card on your pitcher until he gives up a hit. Add +1 to each of his pitches. If your pitcher has the {CY} icon your opponent randomly chooses and discards 1 card from his or her hand. (Playing another Working the Edge on this player will have no effect.)

name: Brainstorm
text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put 1 of them into your hand and discard the others.

name: Caught Looking
text: Draw 2 cards. If your pitcher has the {K} icon you may put a card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

name: Change the Scorecard
text: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck then choose one: Draw those 2 cards or discard those 2 cards and return Change the Scorecard to your hand.

name: Free Steal
text: If your batter has Speed A and second is open he steals it without a throw.

name: Get Under It
text: If your batter rolls a PU or a GB change the result to a FB.

name: Go Yard!
text: Look at your opponent’s hand and choose 2 cards. He or she discards those cards. If the player who hit the HR has the {V} icon your opponent discards his or her hand instead.

name: Good Coaching
text: Remove an offense (red) defense (blue) or utility (white) card that is attached to a player.

name: Great Range
text: Play Great Range only if there is a runner on first. Roll a die: 1-4: Each runner advances 1 base. Draw a card. 5-16: No effect. 17-20: The runner on first is out and your opponent draws a card.

name: High Heat
text: Discard a card. Change the result to a SO.

name: Just Called Up
text: Play Just Called Up only on a player with the {R} icon. Add +3 to the swing.

name: Just Over the Wall
text: If the total swing was 20 or more make an outfield Fielding check. If it succeeds change the result to a FB that advances each runner 1 base.

name: Leadoff Man
text: If your batter has Speed A and hits first or second in your batting order subtract 2 from the pitch or add +3 to the swing. If that batter has the {SB} icon and gets a BB or 1B result you may make a stolen-base attempt using that player. (You can steal a base only if it’s open.)

name: Lofted
text: Roll a die. 1-10: No effect. 11-20: Change the result to a HR.

name: Missed the Cutoff
text: If the defense tried to throw a runner out at home runners on first and second advance 1 base.

name: Momentum Swing
text: Play Momentum Swing only if you’re losing by 2 or more runs. Leave this card on your opponent’s pitcher until the end of the inning. Subtract 1 from each pitch.

name: Preparation
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: Name a card. Your opponent reveals his or her hand. If the named card is there search his or her deck and hand and put all cards with that name into the discard pile.

name: Shaken
text: Play Shaken only if your last 2 (or more) batters got hit results this inning. Add +3 to the swing. (A walk isn't a hit.)

name: Shell Game
text: You and your opponent roll the die. Whoever rolls higher may choose: Draw 2 cards or your opponent discards 2 cards.

name: Shelled
text: Play Shelled only on a pitcher who’s given up a hit or BB to your last 4 (or more) batters this inning. Leave this card on that pitcher until the end of the game. Add +2 to each of your batter's swings. (Playing another Shelled on that pitcher will have no effect.)

name: Slider
text: Subtract 1 from the pitch. If the batter gets a PU SO or FB result change the result to a GB.

name: Stranded
when: Play after the third out of an inning.
text: Draw a card for each runner left on base.

name: Superior Athlete
text: Leave this card on your pitcher until the end of the game. Add +2 to your infield Fielding checks. (Playing another Superior Athlete on this player will have no effect.)

name: Taking a Risk
text: You and your opponent flip over the top 3 cards of your decks. Whoever reveals more defense cards puts those cards in his or her hand and discards the others. The loser discards all 3 cards. If there is a tie you both discard all 3 cards and repeat the process.

name: Team Defense
text: If the last batter this inning got a PU GB or FB result add +2 to the pitch. If your pitcher has the {20} icon instead add +3 to the pitch.

name: Texas Leaguer
text: Discard a card. The defense makes an outfield Fielding check at +5. If the check fails change the result to a 1B that doesn’t let runners try for extra bases. If your batter has the {S} icon draw a card.
